firm_data.firm_description: Stein Adler Dabah & Zelkowitz LLP is a client-focused and results-oriented law firm. They provide legal counsel in areas such as real estate, commercial litigation, and private wealth services.
notable_facts: Recognized by Chambers USA as a Leading Real Estate Law Firm.
Offers value-based fee arrangements including blended rates, contingency fees, and success fees.

email.subject: AI for Stein Adler Dabah & Zelkowitz LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Chambers USA recognized Stein Adler as a leading real estate law firm, and I imagine managing real estate and commercial litigation practices across New York means balancing complex deal work with lean resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in NYC to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
